bullish.title: Oppenheimer Reiterates Outperform on Palo Alto Networks, Raises Price Target to $400

bullish.title: Barclays Maintains Overweight on Palo Alto Networks, Raises Price Target to $370

bullish.title: FireMon Integrates with Palo Alto Networks to Help Enterprises Strengthen Security Policy Governance Across Hybrid Environments
